title: Palantir Q1 2026 earnings release
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was USD 1.633 billion, GAAP operating margin was 46%, operating cash flow was USD 899 million, adjusted free cash flow was USD 925 million, and full-year adjusted free-cash-flow guidance was USD 4.2-4.4 billion.
summary: The SEC-hosted issuer release reports exceptional Q1 growth, profitability, cash generation, liquidity, diluted share count, stock compensation, and raised 2026 guidance; it does not quantify revenue attributable to Anduril.
